title: Ponte Amerigo Vespucci
scope: Complete three-span Arno crossing with a shallow haunched concrete deck, paired skewed masonry piers, cutwaters, abutments, raised sidewalks, and open green railings.
heightPolicy: The standard Terrarium field sets a 43 m datum. Deck heights range from 51.65 m to 52.34 m, following the reported 9.5 m height and photo proportions. The lower path and Arno use their mapped surfaces.
limitations: The two pier axes and skewed landings follow the attributed map footprint. Photographs guide deck depth, the cutwater profiles, and the railing pattern.

The coarse global elevation grid undersamples the raised quay roads. The road replacement profile joins the authored deck to the mapped street approaches. Pier foundations and exact absolute elevations are visual approximations. Short landing lips, a southwest sidewalk flare, and a tapered northeast median plate bridge the visible joins to the mapped approaches. The crossing models its permanent exterior.
